join_tests.name: Household ↔ Government
join_tests.question: Does administrative redesign reduce burden without weakening legitimate access, rights or accountability?
join_tests.finding: Operating-system grammar (Front Door CONCEPT_ONLY, Public Decision Receipt, Tell Government Once, accessibility + graceful failure) reduces household systems-integration work while preserving appeal, receipt, and rights-floor pathways on every home.

join_tests.name: Household ↔ Market
join_tests.question: Do reforms preserve competition and household agency rather than merely moving costs around?
join_tests.finding: Market crowding and household-burden tests remain explicit. Essential ≠ government-owned. Business Friction Ledger and eight-gate ownership standard prevent 'efficiency' that only relocates cost.

join_tests.name: Market ↔ Government
join_tests.question: Are regulator, purchaser, provider and investor roles sufficiently separated?
join_tests.finding: HIGH capture homes (healthcare, capital, economic_development, energy, procurement, AI) carry explicit role-split safeguards. Convergence is flagged, not normalized.

join_tests.name: State ↔ Regional
join_tests.question: Does regionalization add real capacity without creating an unaccountable fourth layer of government?
join_tests.finding: REGIONALIZE (9) is capacity/spillover placement, not a fourth polity. Standards remain statewide; delivery can be regional; accountability pathways stay visible to local representation + state oversight.

join_tests.name: State ↔ Local
join_tests.question: Do authority, responsibility and resources travel together?
join_tests.finding: DEVOLVE (3) and MULTI-LEVEL homes require authority+responsibility+resources to travel together. Architecture forbids unfunded subsidiarity as design. Actual resource adequacy is a V2.3 fiscal proof, not invented here.
join_tests.blocker: V2.3 — resource co-travel proof (do not invent funding)

join_tests.name: County ↔ Functional Geography
join_tests.question: Do proposed structures work with actual service/economic relationships rather than assuming county boundaries solve everything?
join_tests.finding: 31/38 MULTI-LEVEL with functional geographies; county opportunity portfolios OFF; political vs functional geography field is explicit. Counties remain democratic homes, not universal service containers.

join_tests.name: Public Money ↔ Institutional Architecture
join_tests.question: Have we accidentally created functions whose institutional home has no coherent fiscal responsibility?
join_tests.finding: No home invents a funded program. Several homes have institutional homes whose fiscal coherence cannot be certified until all-funds federal share (UNK-FISC-001) and debt/pension schedules (UNK-FISC-004) are resolved. Identified, not funded.

join_tests.name: Data ↔ Privacy
join_tests.question: Can Tell Government Once coexist with purpose limitation, rights, security and correction?
join_tests.finding: Tell Government Once is locked with an explicit counter-rule: reuse ≠ unrestricted access. Data-reuse controls (purpose limitation, minimum necessary, logging, retention, visibility, correction, sensitive separation, legal authorization) are part of the operating contract.

join_tests.name: AI ↔ Human Authority
join_tests.question: Does provisional AI placement preserve identifiable human/institutional responsibility despite the missing inventory?
join_tests.finding: AI remains HOLD-COMPLETE / provisional MULTI-LEVEL: state floors, agency execution, independent oversight for high-risk. No AI mega-agency. Human/institutional responsibility preserved by design. Baseline inventory UNKNOWN blocks detailed AI redesign/implementation — not coexistence assessment.
join_tests.blocker: AI baseline inventory UNKNOWN — prerequisite before detailed AI redesign/implementation

join_tests.name: Accessibility ↔ Efficiency
join_tests.question: Do streamlined processes still work for people unable to use the default pathway?
join_tests.finding: Accessibility architecture + graceful failure on all 38 O cards. Digital-first ≠ digital-only. Default design reduces exceptional treatment; accommodations remain mandatory.

join_tests.name: Rural ↔ Scale
join_tests.question: Have consolidation/regionalization/digitalization quietly shifted costs onto rural households through travel, time or lost access?
join_tests.finding: Rural equivalence test is mandatory on every O card. Consolidation/regionalization must show capacity gain without travel/time/access burden transfer. Household Burden Transfer Test below tracks residual risks as transition conditions, not silent acceptances.

join_tests.name: Present ↔ Future
join_tests.question: Have we created structures that only work if future funding, technology, competence or cooperation magically appears?
join_tests.finding: Hostile read: several operating improvements assume later fiscal clarity, legal authority, and transition sequencing. The model does NOT assume those already exist — it classifies them as FISCAL→V2.3, LEGAL→V2.4, TRANSITION→V2.5, TECHNOLOGY, or INSTITUTIONAL CAPACITY. Mediocre Government Test requires ordinary competence; exceptional administrators are not a design dependency.
join_tests.blocker: Downstream gates must prove affordability/authority/transition — not magic

opposition_test.name: Opposition Test
opposition_test.premise: The Arkansas political faction we trust least wins complete electoral control and inherits the proposed system.

abuse_surfaces.risk: Capture of regional boards / opaque project selection
abuse_surfaces.constraint: Statewide standards + visible local representation + transparent selection + appeal; not a fourth polity
Purpose limitation, logging, correction rights, sensitive separation, legal authorization — reuse ≠ unrestricted access
Role splits (regulator≠purchaser≠provider≠investor); independent appeal; Public Decision Receipt
No Black Box chain; rule-review classes; Outcome Ledger independent of program PR
Eight-gate ownership/investment standard supreme; UNK-INST-004 opacity flagged; exit required
Mandatory sunset/review on emergency_government; rights floor statewide
County rankings forbidden; geographic_disparities cannot pre-assign futures; measurement ≠ operator PR

opposition_test.failure_rule: If the only defense is 'responsible people,' the component fails.
opposition_test.verdict: Constraints are structural, not personality-dependent. Residual abuse risk is real and is constrained by role splits, receipts, appeals, sunsets, and eight gates — not by trusting winners.

mediocre_government_test.name: Mediocre Government Test
mediocre_government_test.premise: Nobody is evil — busy, understaffed, distracted, average, occasionally incompetent, old tech, normal turnover.
mediocre_government_test.finding: Operating grammar is designed for ordinary institutional competence: discoverable entry points, explainable decisions, graceful failure, non-digital pathways, Complexity Budget, and no dependence on heroic administrators or unbuilt mega-systems. Front Door is CONCEPT_ONLY — no procurement fantasy.
required_not_heroic: Receipts and appeals that work under turnover
mediocre_government_test.verdict: System remains workable under ordinary competence; exceptional talent is upside, not a load-bearing assumption.
